datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data monthly throughout 2020 across Uganda administrative units. The data represents spatial projections of acute food insecurity phases (IPC 1-5 scale) aggregated by geographic area, with metadata on collection dates, scenarios, and assistance requirements. This constitutes post-event/ongoing impact assessment of food insecurity outcomes.
